rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Increase Limit
rules.requirement: A landlord can raise rent by no more than 3% of current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change for the year, whichever is less. The current maximum allowable increase for September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027 is 2.87%.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Ord. (Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction)
rules.quotedSpan: The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.
rules.coverageDescription: All residential rental units in Santa Ana.
warnings: Source does not provide the ordinance number or official code citation; description of the rule comes from city web page describing the ordinance.
Source does not state an effective date for the rent increase rule.

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Requirement
rules.requirement: A landlord must have a valid reason to evict a tenant, such as non-payment of rent, breach of lease, or the landlord's intent to occupy the property themselves.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Ord. (Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction)
rules.quotedSpan: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you. This could be for not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.
rules.coverageDescription: All residential rental units in Santa Ana.
warnings: Source does not provide specific list of valid eviction reasons, notice periods, or relocation assistance amounts.
Source does not state an effective date for the just cause eviction rule.

rules.title: Santa Ana Relocation Assistance for Certain Evictions
rules.requirement: If a landlord evicts a tenant for certain reasons, the landlord may be required to provide relocation assistance to help pay for the tenant's moving costs.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Ord. (Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction)
rules.quotedSpan: If your landlord evicts you for certain reasons, they might have to help pay for your moving costs.
rules.coverageDescription: All residential rental units in Santa Ana.
warnings: Source does not specify which eviction reasons trigger relocation assistance or the amount of assistance required.

rules.title: Santa Ana Registration Fee Pass-Through Cap
rules.requirement: A landlord may charge a pass-through fee of up to $50 per rental unit per month to cover registration costs under the Rent Stabilization Ordinance. If a landlord charges more than $50, the landlord must reimburse the tenant for the overpayment.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Ord. (Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction)
rules.quotedSpan: If a landlord charges a tenant a pass-through fee greater than $50, the landlord shall reimburse the tenant for the registration fee pass-through overpayment. The pass-through fee is charged by rental unit, not by the number of tenants in a rental unit.
rules.coverageDescription: All residential rental units in Santa Ana.
warnings: Source does not state an effective date for the pass-through fee rule.
Source indicates landlords are not required to charge the pass-through fee, only that it is allowed.
